findings.title: Action becoming maintained practice
findings.claim: The focus rebuke can be read as moving from people hurrying into transgression in 5:62 to a wrongdoing practice that learned authorities help produce and maintain in 5:63.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the focus pair of the formative authority title and the closing making predicate. The independent trigger is 5:62's speeding, transgression, and individual-action sequence together with the repeated offense frame. Their contact changes the reading from wrongdoing merely being done to the same wrongdoing acquiring a socially maintained form when expected restraint is omitted.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing verdict reaches the way wrongdoing becomes durable, while the direct condemnation of the sinful speech and illicit consumption remains fully recoverable.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that learned authorities should restrain the named wrongs and that their conduct is condemned. This adds a qualified causal layer; the live alternative is that yasna'una intensifies the censure without reallocating causality.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace supplies exact focus and 5:62 coordinates, a changed reading, and an explicit alternative, but its reader identity is legacy-unbound and three contextual branch records remain unresolved.

findings.title: An office tested by its intervention
findings.claim: The focus's conditional rebuke can be read as testing whether a learned title is being enacted through its defining intervention: when restraint is omitted, the office itself appears unfulfilled.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers are the two learned-authority titles and the verb of restraint. The independent trigger is 5:67's messenger office, delivery action, and counterfactual equation between omitting the action and failing the office. Their contact returns through the focus restraint verb and makes the duty-bearing title answerable to conduct.
findings.reader_payoff: The question reaches beyond why a prohibition was left unsaid and makes the reader see the named offices as roles whose reality is tested by the intervention they owe.
findings.containment: The direct reading remains that the rabbaniyyun and ahbar should restrain sinful speech and illicit consumption. This is an analogical extension from the messenger passage; the prophetic commission may be unique and may not define the learned offices in the same way.

epistemic.reason: The trace provides exact 5:67 and focus coordinates, an explicit before/after movement, and a live analogical alternative, while its reader identity is legacy-unbound and the context branch records are unresolved.

findings.title: Scarcity speech and extraction
findings.claim: The focus's condemned saying and illicit consumption can be read, in light of 5:64, as a speech-supported extraction process in which a scarcity rationale helps make illicit gain and appeasement seem necessary.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers are circulating speech, wealth consumption, forbidden gain, and the making predicate. The independent trigger is 5:64's claim of a bound hand, its reversal by spread hands and spending, and its sequence of recurring conflict and corruption. Their contact changes the reading from two adjacent wrongs to a possible process in which discourse supplies a rationale, extraction supplies the material result, and appeasement helps reproduce the arrangement.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the saying as participating in the production of the illicit gain, while the direct meaning of sinful speech and forbidden consumption stays intact.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains a condemnation of sinful saying and illicit gain. This is an exploratory causal reading of the supplied sequence; the live alternative is that 5:63 and 5:64 place adjacent indictments together without establishing that causal chain.

epistemic.reason: The trace supplies exact focus and 5:64 coordinates, an anchored before/after movement, and an explicit causal alternative, but its reader identity is legacy-unbound, the context branch records are unresolved, and the causal arrow is authorial inference.
